svg.title: H S Bharath Surya — intro
svg.desc: Portrait and intro text drawn as thousands of particles that burst into dust and pull back together. CS student at Newton School of Technology in Bengaluru. I design AI systems that route work across models, call tools, and keep a human approving the decisions that matter: Python, FastAPI, LLM workflows and n8n.
